messages:
Marin: quick heads up — platform wants to deprecate the internal handshake header we surface in the SDKs (x-rd-routehint). timetable = ~3 weeks. need a rollout + docs plan.
Sam: ack. is this just a rename or behavioral change?
Marin: mostly a rename + semantics tightening. new header = x-rd-route (canonical) and we will require explicit route version in body for narrowcast. legacy header will be accepted w/ deprecation warning for 3 weeks then 1 week grace before dropping.
Leo: should we do a silent shim in platform that translates v1 -> v2 for clients that still send old header? we can log telemetry to see usage.
Zara: shim is possible but prefer we force opt-in for translation via feature flag per-tenant. ops asked for visibility so we can revoke shim quickly.
Ashley: SDK side: Python/TS/Go all currently set x-rd-routehint by default in client internals. that's a breaking change if we flip behavior. propose: 1) add opt-in flag in SDK config 'route_v2:true' 2) add telemetry event when old header used 3) ship patch doc + migration snippet.
Marin: +1. timeline: week 0 announce, week 1 SDK patch with opt-in, week 2 opt-in becomes default but platform shim still accepts v1, week 3 remove shim.
Sam: will need console UX note for rollouts: per-route dashboard should surface "legacy header usage" metric and tenant migration status. ops needs this to approve removal.
Zara: logging: dev-bot can emit a weekly summary to #eng-platform with top 10 tenants still using v1. can we hook telemetry to console ingestion?
dev-bot: (automation) weekly report scheduled: route-header-deprecation report -> #eng-platform every Monday 09:00 UTC.
Leo: SDK change details: minimal API diff. in Python client: add Client(..., route_header_compat=null) where null = follow server default, true = send new header, false = explicit old behavior. default upgrade opt-in will be feature-flagged.
Ashley: TS/Go need matching surface. also update quickstarts and examples on docs site. add migration snippet:
```python
# migration example
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=KEY, route_header_compat=true)
resp = cli.complete(..., route_id='prod-us-west')
```
Zara: telemetry events: send `route.header.migration` with fields: ["tenant_id","client_lang","header_sent","shim_used"]. make them low-sample but not zero.
Sam: console: we'll add a tile to the routing dashboard showing % requests using new header + list of active tenants flagged for shim. can devex help with copy and SDK doc links?
Marin: yes please — need a short migration guide in devex docs, an expanded section in SDK changelog, and a migration banner in Console for tenants with >5% legacy usage.
Ashley: will prepare PRs for Python + TS + Go today. will include deprecation warning log when sending v1 header and env var to toggle behavior.
Leo: note: internal API team also changing handshake endpoint; SDKs must not start calling new endpoint until we pass canary on perf tests. I'll coordinate with runtime.
Marin: agreed — block on runtime canary. also add QA checklist: integration tests for header negotiation, e2e with Dedicated + Private.
Zara: Ops asks for rollback plan: keep shim for +24h after removal in case of spike, feature-flag off and quick rollback doc.
Sam: ok. next steps: Ashley send SDK PRs -> Marin will post migration draft -> Zara will wire telemetry and dev-bot report -> Leo coordinate canary -> Sam add console tile mock. target: announce EOD tomorrow to internal docs.
Marin: thanks all. I'll post a short bulletin in #devex when docs draft is up. :thumbsup:
